metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Mr Bogomips, each one hosted in its own repository

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: General-purpose agent skills: handoff, done, pause, tldr, the AGENTS.md family, Gemini web research, image generation.

plugins.name: eng-artifacts
plugins.description: Skills for the optimized production of software engineering artifacts (entity relationship diagrams first) as self-contained pages with one shared visual language, a light/dark toggle and replaceable themes.

plugins.name: eng-skills
plugins.description: Skills and agents for engineering work, technical writing first: doc comments, API references, error messages, manuals and release notes written for the audience each text reaches, with requirement IDs kept out of published text and traceability kept in implementation comments; a leak scanner, a writer agent and an independent reviewer agent.

plugins.name: harness-maker
plugins.description: Stand up, assess, and maintain an agentic harness in an existing repo: generate project-specific agent teams and the skills they use, assess how effectively they are used, advise on spec-driven development systems, agent-suited issue trackers and a domain-fitting visual stack, check the machine for the tools a harness needs, and file tool-improvement feedback upstream.

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: Session retrospective — links the errors, reworks and ambiguities of a session to the skills, rules, CLAUDE.md, memory, hooks and settings behind them, and applies only explicitly authorized, reviewed fixes to the project's own files.

plugins.name: personal-voice
plugins.description: Personal writing voice — writes documents, emails and messages in the author's tone and lexicon, learns from the author's revisions and own texts, and maintains the profile only with per-item approval.

plugins.name: pm-artifacts
plugins.description: Decision boards for project managers as self-contained pages: an agile board with sprints and capacity, epics, roadmap, progress with release fit and people allocation, with the findings to decide on; editable and saved in place when published as an artifact.
